categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three primary business segments: (1) EDA software for integrated circuit yield enhancement, including test chip design tools, DFM (Design for Manufacturability) tools, and DFT (Design for Testability) tools; (2) Semiconductor big data analysis and management systems covering yield analysis, defect management, and equipment monitoring; (3) Wafer-level electrical testing equipment (WAT test equipment) and related testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include addressable test chip design methodology, high-density test chip design and rapid testing techniques, fast electrical parameter testing solutions, and semiconductor big data analysis methods. The company develops parametric design tools (SmtCell, TCMagic, ATCompiler), DFM/DFT software platforms, and manufactures wafer-level electrical testing equipment (T4000 series, T4100S series) using proprietary matrix switch architecture and advanced control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves integrated circuit design companies (Fabless), wafer foundries (Fab), and integrated device manufacturers (IDM). Primary customers include major semiconductor manufacturers and design companies in China and internationally. End markets include logic chips, memory (DRAM, NAND Flash, SRAM), CIS sensors, BCD processes, and third-generation compound semiconductors (SiC/GaN).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Shanghai, Changsha, Shenzhen, Beijing, and Singapore. The company serves customers across Asia-Pacific region and maintains international presence through its Singapore subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain. It provides design tools and testing equipment/services to semiconductor manufacturers and design companies, positioning itself between chip design and manufacturing execution, supporting the entire product lifecycle from design through production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) expanding EDA software portfolio with DFM and DFT tools; (2) developing AI-powered semiconductor data analysis platforms (INF-AI, SemiMind); (3) advancing wafer-level reliability testing and on-chip monitoring solutions; (4) extending yield enhancement solutions from process development to mass production; (5) pursuing international market expansion, particularly in Korea, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple models: (1) Software tool licensing with fixed-term authorization fees recognized over service periods; (2) Software technical development services recognized upon customer acceptance; (3) Testing equipment sales recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance; (4) Testing services recognized upon completion of testing and delivery of analysis reports; (5) Permanent software licensing recognized at delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens) and emerging domestic competitors. The company positions itself as a leading domestic supplier of yield enhancement solutions with comprehensive software-hardware integration. It has achieved recognition through industry awards and customer certifications, establishing competitive advantages in cost-effectiveness and localized support compared to international competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of 546.87 million yuan, representing 14.50% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 80.27 million yuan (down 37.68% YoY), with total assets of 3.41 billion yuan. The company shows strong revenue growth trajectory with expanding product portfolio, though profitability declined due to increased R&D investments and market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's differentiation lies in providing comprehensive, integrated solutions combining EDA software, testing equipment, and data analysis services for yield enhancement. Key value propositions include: (1) Full-flow coverage from design to production monitoring; (2) AI-powered intelligent manufacturing solutions; (3) Cost-effective domestic alternatives to international vendors; (4) Deep expertise in yield optimization and defect management; (5) Customized solutions supporting advanced process nodes and emerging technologies like HBM and compound semiconductors.
